hook.say: Europe's smaller countries are surprisingly hard to rank. Which is bigger? Five duels, three seconds each!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which is bigger: Bulgaria or Greece?
questions.fact: Greece is about 19% bigger than Bulgaria.
questions.sayAnswer: Greece! It is about nineteen percent bigger than Bulgaria.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Portugal or Austria?
questions.fact: Portugal is about 10% bigger than Austria.
questions.sayAnswer: Portugal! It is about ten percent bigger than Austria.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Ireland or Czechia?
questions.say: Which is bigger: Ireland or the Czech Republic?
questions.fact: Czechia is about 12% bigger than the Republic of Ireland.
questions.sayAnswer: The Czech Republic! It is about twelve percent bigger than the Republic of Ireland.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Switzerland or Estonia?
questions.fact: Estonia is about 10% bigger than Switzerland.
questions.sayAnswer: Estonia! It is about ten percent bigger than Switzerland.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Poland or Italy?
questions.fact: Poland is about 3.5% bigger than Italy.
questions.sayAnswer: Poland! It is about three and a half percent bigger than Italy.
